name: Aegisaur
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 11. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A squat four-legged herbivore with overlapping shell-like armored scales and a massive bony club at the end of its tail.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), page 28. Reskin of Ankylosaurus, Monster Manual (2014), printed p. 79.
sections.Actions: Tail. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit for 18 (4d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit by the tail must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.At the table: Resolve damage and the Strength save on the same hit. A prone creature must use half its speed to stand.

name: Aerosaur (Large)
otherStatistics: Perception +2. Passive Perception 12. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A long-beaked flying reptile with a light crest and wide leathery wings. The shared portrait uses muted rust-brown membranes and subdued moss-green crest scales.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), page 29. Reskin of Quetzalcoatlus, Volo’s Guide to Monsters (2016), printed p. 140.
sections.Traits:
Dive Attack. While flying, dive at least 30 ft. toward the target and hit it with Bite to deal 10 (3d6) extra damage.
Flyby. Leaving an enemy’s reach in flight does not provoke an opportunity attack.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit for 12 (3d6 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.At the table: The dive is part of movement. Add the extra damage when the Bite hits after the qualifying dive.

name: Altisaur
otherStatistics: Constitution save +6. Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A towering four-legged herbivore with a long tree-browsing neck, broad barrel-shaped body, and a long tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: James Wyatt, Plane Shift: Ixalan, first printing (January 2018), page 27. Reskin of Brontosaurus, Volo’s Guide to Monsters (2016), printed p. 139.
sections.Actions:
Stomp. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit for 27 (5d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A target hit by the stomp must pass a DC 14 Strength save or fall prone.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit for 32 (6d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: Either action can reach as far as 20 ft. Stomp adds a Strength save on a hit.

otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed languages or special senses.
appearance: A four-legged herbivore with spikelike plates rising along its spine and sharp spikes on its flexible tail.
